notes.title: Addition of chroma key background option (Version 1.5.0 update).
notes.notes:
The version has been updated. The changes are as follows:

■ Version 1.5.0
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971681/1eae4e43389c95756cbf31a5c24499bd53b11718.png

Added a "Chroma Key Background" setting in the configuration. When this is turned ON, the background of the puzzle area will be set to #000000. By using this as a chroma key, it is now easier to create videos or live streams with any image as the background. This can be configured from the "Settings" menu.
Fixed an issue where the BGM wouldn't switch when pressing "END" from the results screen to return to the title screen.

notes.title: Keyboard and Controller Operations Largely Supported (Version 1.4.3 Update)
notes.notes:
■ Version 1.4.3

Enabled nearly all UI operations using the keyboard. You can navigate the UI with ←→↑↓ and confirm with Enter. Pressing the X button will return you to the default position. Press the Space key to open the configuration menu during gameplay.
Enabled nearly all UI operations using a controller (gamepad). You can navigate the UI with ←→↑↓ and confirm with the south button (A on Xbox, × on PlayStation). The east button (B on Xbox, ○ on PlayStation) returns you to the default position. Press the Start button to open the configuration menu during gameplay.
Fixed an issue where certain special operations could cause the game to become unplayable.
Fixed an issue where the left and right orientation of the store clerk and store manager would change when calling up the configuration menu from in-game.
Changed the leaderboard display from showing up to 300 ranks to displaying up to 500 ranks when accessed from the game.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 (Compensation for Collection Issue)
notes.notes:
We have identified an issue where the data in the "Collection" section becomes corrupted when upgrading from version 1.0 to version 1.1 or higher after creating save data in version 1.0.
Unfortunately, it is difficult to fix or restore this issue. We sincerely apologize for this inconvenience.

To help restore the situation to some extent, we have added a one-time process to add points based on the achievements currently unlocked:

No achievements: 20,000 points
Achievement for collecting 20 or more items: 60,000 points
Achievement for collecting 40 or more items: 120,000 points
Achievement for collecting 60 or more items: 160,000 points
Achievement for collecting 80 or more items: 400,000 points
Achievement for collecting 100 or more items: 2,000,000 points
The release of this version, which includes this process, is scheduled for JST 6/22.

We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update (Minor Fixes)
notes.notes:
Added testers to the credits for their cooperation in playtesting.
Corrected the collection item "【絵】つかさ姫花_5" where the manager was visible, to "【絵】つかさ姫花店長_1."
Added "SKIP" text to clearly indicate that users can skip the gacha animation stages by clicking the screen. The loop of "10 consecutive gachas → skip animation → close" can also be performed by repeatedly pressing the Enter key.
Slightly adjusted the hashtags included in the default post text when pressing the X post button.
Fixed an issue where the "close" button, when clicked and reopened, would keep the screen zoomed in.
Corrected a problem where pressing the Enter key on the gacha result screen, while the item details are open, would allow the gacha to be spun again without closing the item details screen. Now, pressing the Enter key in this state will close the item details screen.
Addressed an issue where input from left or right keys during piece drop was active, causing pieces to dislodge from the trolley.
